source_text.GH#2700: TypeAccess on primary and every join target (/query, export, aggregate).

task.description: ELIXIR-DEV implementation of the GH #2700 design. No tests written, nothing committed.

result.summary: Implemented per design. New lib/letflow/entities/request_access.ex (check/4: request_entity_types -> TypeAccess.denied_types -> Allowlist.fk_defs for EVERY distinct type with no short-circuit, one decision after (denied or any non-{:ok,_} read -> :entity_type_not_found; :invalid_schema_name propagates) -> unchanged FieldPolicy.check_request/4 with exempt? forwarded only there). TypeAccess.denied_types/3 (single tenant lookup + one query, Enum.uniq names bound as type(^names,{:array,:string}), UUID cast kept, [] returns empty set with no I/O). Compiler.join_shape_error() type and Compiler.join_entity_types/1 (check_join_shape then through,entity_type per clause, request order, not deduped). RequestGuard.request_entity_types/2 (walk first: registry keys, entity_type_class classification table, join list/element/through well-formedness; then Compiler.join_entity_types; uniq with primary first; never raises) plus public RequestGuard.entity_type_class/1 for the tripwire test. Router: run_query/run_export/run_query_aggregate call only RequestAccess.check; guard_row_request/2, the later TypeAccess step, the {:ok,:denied} else clause, the {:checked,_} redact clause removed (redact/3 now takes the sets map; run_query binds {:ok, %{sets: sets}}); render_type_hidden/1 and refusal shapes unchanged (/query 200-empty, export/aggregate 404); unredacted export does not lift denial; no log/audit on denial. Stale comments and moduledoc route-table rows (query, query_aggregate, export_records) reworded; removed now-unused FieldPolicy alias from router. VERIFICATION: MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean (twice, before and after mix format); mix format ran; mix letflow.check_boundaries OK (1372 edges, 0 violations). No tests run (not asked). Mutex taken and released.
deviations: request_entity_types/2 also fails closed (:request_clause_unwalked) for a non-binary/absent primary entity_type, matching field_refs/3.
RequestGuard.entity_type_class/1 added as a public accessor so T-15 can classify without reaching into a module attribute; design named only the table.
Compiler.join_entity_types/1 order per clause is [through, entity_type] (design did not fix the order).
ensure_all_visible treats any non-{:ok,_} read other than :invalid_schema_name as absent (fail closed).

caller_grep.lib: TypeAccess.authorized? only in router render_get_definition (~915); FieldPolicy.check_request only in RequestAccess (router has zero code uses); Compiler.join_relations only in RequestGuard.join_refs; script_reads.ex, modules/exam/*, mix letflow.seed.exam_fixtures compile server-authored requests without TypeAccess (design F8, out of scope, unchanged).
caller_grep.web/src: no caller of query/aggregate, records/<type>/export or any join/through request body (matches in web/src/api/definitions.ts and SolutionPackUpdateLauncherPage.tsx are unrelated string matches)

tests_to_touch: test/letflow/routers/entities_query_restricted_walker_test.exs T-39 (~1375-1430: expects guard_row_request, FieldPolicy.check_request in run_export/aggregate, 'exempt?: false' in guard_row_request) and A-12 (~1432-1468) -- will FAIL, replace per design 3.1/T-18
test/letflow/entities/query_cursor_field_grants_test.exs chain-order test (~975-1030): still asserts compile<paginate<redact and should pass; extend to RequestAccess.check( before Compiler.compile(
test/specs/GH2697-query-restricted.md (T-39/M5/M10 wording), possibly test/specs/GH2699-aggregate-join-restricted.md and REQ-394.md wording

test/letflow/routers/entities_test.exs and entities_aggregate_test.exs: tests combining a join error (field_not_allowed) with an absent later target now answer not-found (design R2); grep field_not_allowed with join
test/letflow/entities/query_request_guard_test.exs: FieldPolicy.check_request calls still valid (unchanged API); add T-14/T-15
notes_for_test_designer: RequestAccess.check/4 requires principal %{user_id, prefix} and opts %{exempt?: _}; denied/absent both return {:error, :entity_type_not_found}.
request_entity_types/2 returns [primary | per join: through, entity_type] uniq; shape errors come only after the walk.
denied_types/3 with [] makes zero queries including no tenant lookup; invalid prefix returns {:error, :invalid_schema_name} for non-empty input.
redact/3 in the router no longer has a {:checked,_} clause.
